methodology: MERRA-2 monthly volumetric soil moisture, 0-5 cm surface layer (M2TMNXLND SFMC), version 5.12.4, accessed through NASA Harmony (GES DISC subset) as an area-averaged monthly time series, converted from m3/m3 to m3/m3. Whole calendar years only. Trends are computed afterwards by the analysis module (seasonal Mann-Kendall with Sen's slope); this file describes the data only.
limitations: Each value is an average over the region's box, so it hides what happens inside the box.
Giovanni snaps the requested box to the product's grid; the region it actually analysed is recorded in the provenance.
MERRA-2 is a model reconstruction constrained by observations, not a direct measurement. Changes in what it assimilates can create artificial steps in a record.
Months with no value are kept as empty rows, never filled in.
This is a land-surface field averaged over the box's grid cells without weighting by land fraction (MERRA-2 FRLAND), so coastal cells count in full.
attribution: MERRA-2 monthly volumetric soil moisture, 0-5 cm surface layer (M2TMNXLND SFMC). NASA Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC), accessed through NASA Harmony (GES DISC subset) on 2026-11-14.
